description: The script snippet feature: one operation no feature can do, as its own feature block on the active part, kept next to the insert_* features instead of replacing the whole part. gap names the missing feature or option, why says why the existing feature did not work, script is the operation (it reads and sets part). The block starts with // FEATURE-GAP: <gap> | <why>, which the feature backlog is grepped from. All three are required; an empty one is bad_args. Prefer insert_* whenever a feature can do the job; use set_script only to rewrite a whole part. Working copy only; git_save commits. Writes (defaults): Script snippet — one operation no feature can do, with its FEATURE-GAP note Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: insert_code_snippet
